page_title: EIN 0-0 UNI | Eintracht Frankfurt v Union Berlin 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
90+4' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90+4' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Frederik Ronnow.
90+2' The substitution has been made. Timothy Chandler (Eintracht Frankfurt) has replaced Junior Dina Ebimbe.
90+2' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
90+1' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Marco Fritz shows the yellow card to Willian Pacho (Eintracht Frankfurt) for a heavy challenge.
89' Here is a change. Robin Gosens is going off and Nenad Bjelica gives the last tactical orders to Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin).
89' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
87' CHANCE! Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top.
86' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but sends his header miles wide of the right post.
85' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
85' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
82' Nenad Bjelica decides to make a substitution. Christopher Trimmel will be replaced by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
81' A pass by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
80' The attendance for today's match is 57100.
79' Here's the change. Ansgar Knauff leaves the pitch and Jean Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on as a substitute.
79' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
79' A wild effort from Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
78' The resulting corner from Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) comes to nothing.
77' The game is interrupted as Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) is flagged offside.
74' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
72' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
71' That will be all from Hugo Ekitike who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).

68' Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.

67' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Fritz blows his whistle for an infringement. Eintracht Frankfurt are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
65' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Brenden Aaronson cannot continue after picking up an injury.
65' Nenad Bjelica has decided to make a change. Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) replaces Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen.
65' The substitution is prepared. Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yorbe Vertessen.
61' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) sees a yellow card from Marco Fritz after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
59' The resulting corner from Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) is cleared by the defence.

58' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) gets inside the box and tries to beat Frederik Ronnow with a measured shot into the top right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Eintracht Frankfurt.
53' Rough tackle by Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Marco Fritz saw the whole situation.
46' Dino Toppmoller makes a half-time substitution. Philipp Max (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Niels Nkounkou.
46' Marco Fritz blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45' The end of the first half.
44' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
44' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
44' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
43' Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
41' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a crack at goal from the edge of the box, but it drifts high over the bar to safety.
38' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
38' Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marco Fritz didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
33' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
32' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
32' Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul after Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) hacks down one of his opponents.
31' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

30' Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The linesman makes the right call and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a corner.
27' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
24' A yellow card for a tackle by Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt). Marco Fritz doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
23' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Kevin Trapp easily deals with the threat.
20' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
16' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) is flagged for offside.
15' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough foul. Marco Fritz stops the game and makes a call.
12' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
9' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Fritz blows for a foul. Union Berlin will take a free kick.
7' Poor challenge! Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) is penalised for tripping and Marco Fritz blows his whistle.
5' The ball falls kindly for Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the left post.
4' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
3' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) swings in a cross from the corner, but Frederik Ronnow reads it well and gathers the ball.
1' The match has just started.
Union Berlin will kick the game off.
Marco Fritz will supervise the game today.
